EmailTemplate.name: MOD Extension Email Response
EmailTemplate.subject: {!Case.Merchant_Number__c} - {!Account.Legal_Name__c}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello,
We have received your request to extend your current or recent temporary loan modification due to the Covid-19 pandemic.
Please provide your {!Case.Last_Month__c} bank statement and your {!Case.Current_Month__c} month to date transaction history for extension to be considered.
Please reply to this email with all the requested information and attachments. Once received, our team will review and a credit manager will respond as soon as possible*. We wish you and your family the best during this difficult time. Visit our site for updates and support for our customers: {!Case.Email_Website_Address__c}
Thank you,
Modification Department
{!Case.Email_Signature_Company__c}
9820 Towne Centre Drive San Diego, CA 92121
